dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What do you do in your free time, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt duː juː ˈduː ɪn jʊr ˈfriː ˈtaɪm, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I love taking photos. It's my favorite hobby.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ˈteɪkɪŋ ˈfoʊtoʊz. ɪts maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈhɑːbi.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nice! What do you take photos of?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs! ˈwʌt duː juː ˈteɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈʌv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Food and flowers. And you, Emma?
dialogue.reading: ˈfuːd ənd ˈflaʊərz. ənd ˈjuː, ˈɛmə?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I enjoy drawing. I draw every day.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈdrɔːɪŋ. aɪ ˈdrɔː ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? I like drawing, too, but I'm not very good.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈdrɔːɪŋ, ˈtuː, bʌt aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let's draw together after class tomorrow!
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈdrɔː təˈɡɛðər ˈæftər ˈklæs təˈmɑːroʊ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! And I can take photos of you!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ənd aɪ kən ˈteɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz əv ˈjuː!
